text:
```yaml
name: Check Dist

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v41
        with:
          files: dist/**
          
      - name: Fail if dist files were changed
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "❌ dist/ directory was modified in this pull request."
          echo "This workflow prevents untrusted dist changes from being merged."
          echo "Please do not modify dist/ directly. Run 'npm run build' and 'npm run package' instead."
          exit 1
```
